behavior.reviewedArtifactsOnly: The administration API accepts only template key/version, review reference and, for rollback, the expected revision; template hash, golden hash and certification reference are computed from reviewed local files and never accepted from the caller.
behavior.localGoldenOracle: Only payments.success_rate_daily@1.0.0 has a local synthetic golden oracle. Other templates fail closed with DATA_TEMPLATE_GOLDEN_UNAVAILABLE.
behavior.publish: Requires a reviewed template artifact, a local golden file whose template key/version/hash match, the five required golden aspects, synthetic-only tenant events and oracle equality. Duplicate versions are rejected; existing versions cannot be overwritten in place.
behavior.rollback: Requires the version to exist, the passed template/certification/golden hashes to equal the stored immutable version, and an exact active-revision CAS. Semantic version ordering is preserved in listings.
behavior.executionGate: oa_company_data_template_is_active is checked when a data scope is acquired and rechecked during execution retention. After a newer version is published, a superseded version is denied locally with no upstream call and no new audit row.
permissions: live TENANT_ADMIN binding with TENANT scope is required for publish and rollback
tenant-scoped advisory lock protects the active pointer
immutable tenant/admin/request receipts bind operation, arguments hash and review hash; replay returns the stored result, mismatched reuse returns a conflict
oa_app reads template versions and the active pointer only; oa_runtime additionally executes only the active-version predicate
oa_app and oa_runtime cannot write lifecycle tables or execute the admin mutation function
http: GET /api/v1/data/templates lists local lifecycle summaries with cache-control private, no-store
POST /api/v1/data/templates/publish and POST /api/v1/data/templates/rollback require session, CSRF and a UUID idempotency key
unknown fields are rejected; employee sessions receive 403
wired only in DEFAULT runtime mode
behavior.audit: Existing company data execution audit remains status/completeness/queryId/template provenance only; superseded-version denial writes no execution row.
